title: HR Management Platform
tagline: Full-stack HR system: employee records, leave tracking, document management. Built solo.
longDesc: An end-to-end HR platform for small and mid-sized teams. Employee directory, leave requests with approval flows, document storage, and role-based access. Built and shipped solo — design through deploy.

title: FirstShift
tagline: Shift scheduling app for hourly teams — built on the pain of manual roster management.
longDesc: Drag-and-drop weekly scheduler for hourly workers. Shift swaps, time-off, conflict detection, and role-based views for managers vs staff. Designed around the actual workflow of a manager building a roster on a Sunday night.

title: ClockDeck
tagline: Time tracking dashboard. Clean dashboard UX, real-time clock-in/out.
longDesc: A time-tracking SaaS dashboard with real-time clock-in/out, weekly summaries, and exportable reports. Focus on dashboard UX clarity — at a glance, you know who's on the clock and who isn't.

title: OceanBlue Corp
tagline: Production website for a real company. Marketing site + content systems + deployment.
longDesc: Production marketing site for OceanBlue, including content management, SEO, and deployment. The first time my work was live for a real customer base — taught me what 'production' actually means.

title: OB Resume Builder
tagline: Contributed to a team codebase — Python tooling for an active company project.
longDesc: A team codebase I contributed to — Python tooling and integrations for an active company resume product. Real collaboration: branches, PRs, code review, working with someone else's conventions.
